items.title: Stocks lost $2 trillion. The market is wrong about AI
items.summary: The stock market lost $2 trillion in 40 minutes, and AI stocks took the worst of it, with Intel down more than half since October and AMD off 17% in a day. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why it happened and why he thinks the market is wrong, from GPU rental prices up 106% to the CPU boom and Anthropic's IPO valuation.

items.title: Latest News In AI Chips - Race to Dominate AI Infrastructure Accelerates Globally
items.summary: The global race for AI infrastructure supremacy is intensifying as major technology players significantly increase their investments in next-generation data center accelerators. According to BCC Research, the surging demand for AI, machine learning, and data-intensive workloads is driving a shift from traditional CPU-based architectures to advanced accelerators like GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, and ASICs.
